lines.say: Your mother has four minutes left. And you're forty dollars short.
Her care plan expired at midnight. The machine doesn't care.
You call the bank. A robot tells you to hold.
So you run. You sell your jacket. Twenty dollars.
Your neighbor Doris gives you ten. It's all she has.
Above the city, the man who owns this hospital finishes dinner.
Thirty seconds. You're still ten dollars short.
Who would you call? Write it in the comments.
